en.headline: Ombudsman launches investigation into LCSD management of public study rooms
en.dek: The probe examines reports of seat abuse, noise and misuse in library and sports centre study rooms that affect students with genuine revision needs.
body: The Ombudsman, Jack Chan, announced on Thursday the launch of a direct investigation into the Leisure and Cultural Services Department's management of its study rooms.

The Office of the Ombudsman noted recurring reports of library study rooms being abused, including occupying seats without using them, causing noise or odour nuisances, taking short breaks, holding meetings and using power sockets merely for charging devices. These practices deprive students with genuine needs of quiet spaces for revision, particularly during examination periods.

The LCSD manages 71 public libraries, of which 36 have students' study rooms. It has also set up study rooms inside 26 sports centres, 20 of which open during the examination season from March to early May and six of which operate year-round. The investigation will examine enforcement against abuse, the operation of the admission-card system, the suitability of study rooms in sports centres and related management issues.

Chan said study rooms are valuable public resources that should be available to those with genuine needs, especially public examination candidates and students from grassroots or disadvantaged backgrounds who lack a quiet environment at home. The Ombudsman invited written views from the public by 28 December.

zh.headline: 申訴專員主動調查康文署自修室管理 關注霸位及濫用問題
zh.dek: 公署指圖書館及體育場館自修室不時出現霸位不用、噪音氣味滋擾等情況，影響真正有需要溫習的學生。
body: 申訴專員陳積志今日宣布展開主動調查行動，詳細審研康樂及文化事務署對轄下自修室的管理。
申訴專員公署留意到不時有關於圖書館自修室被濫用的報導，相關行為包括「霸位但不用」、噪音和氣味滋擾，以及濫用作短暫休息、會面及臨時電源充電之用等，導致確有需要地方溫習的學生失去溫習機會。公署視察時亦多次發現有關情況。
康文署轄下共有71間公共圖書館，其中36間設有學生自修室。該署亦於26間體育場館附設自修室，當中20間於考試季節開放，6間全年開放。調查將涵蓋執管濫用問題、入座證制度的運作、在體育場館設置自修室的適切性及相關管理事宜。
陳積志表示，自修室是寶貴公共資源，應讓真正有需要的人士使用，對公開考試考生及缺乏寧靜環境溫習的基層學生尤其重要。公署歡迎市民於12月28日前以書面提出意見。
